sentences.text:
Samar Ghosh & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 4
November, 2024

Bench: Aniruddha Roy
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Constitutional Writ Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
10 04.11.2024
Sc Ct. no.2
 Wpa 146 Of 2024
 -------------

Samar Ghosh & Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Ors.

Mr. Biswarup Biswas .....For the Petitioners Mr. Chandi Charan De, Addl. Govt. Pleader Mr. Anirban
Sarkar.
.....For the Respondent Ms. Manika Roy Ms. Ankita Chowdhury.
.....For the Respondent No.7/NHAI
The order dated August 2, 2024 speaks for itself in detail.

Today Mr. Chandi Charan De, learned Additional Government Pleader files a report in the form of affidavit affirmed on August 28, 2024 on behalf of the office of the Land Acquisition Collector, the same is taken on record.

Ms. Ankita Chowdhury, leaned counsel led by Ms. Manika Roy, learned counsel appearing for the National Highways Authority of India also files a report in the form of affidavit affirmed on September 23, 2024, the same is taken on record.
Learned counsel for the parties are ad idem that, the revised enhanced award for compensation dated June 30, 2016 was passed and the quantum is lying with the respondent no.2.
The land losers petitioners may collect the same in accordance with law.

In view of the above, upon compliance of all the statutory formalities, the petitioners subject to proof of their identity shall collect their compensation from the office of the respondent no.2 and the respondent no.2 shall release and disburse the amount strictly in accordance with law to the petitioners.

It is needless to mention that, in the event it appears that, interest on compensation is payable to the petitioners, the same shall also be paid in accordance with law under the provisions of Section 3H(5)

With the above observations and directions this writ petition, WPA 146 of 2024 stands disposed of without any order as to costs.
